About

Founder's note

M.B.A started as a joke about the state of every MBA student's wallet — and turned into a tee we actually wanted to wear. Mostly Broke Always is the honest version of the acronym on our degree certificates.

Started by a first-year MBA'28 student, printed and sold in small batches, straight to the IIT Jodhpur campus. No warehouse, no middlemen — just a design we're proud of and orders we fulfil one at a time.

First drop is limited. Once the batch sells out, it's gone — no restocks planned for drop 001.
